---
title: "Amateur satellite repeater contacts"
subtitle: "KF8EEZ, Dayton OH (39.76, -84.19, 225 m): pass plans for two-way FM satellites"
---

Pass planning for making contacts through FM satellite repeaters: SO-50,
LilacSat-2 and the ISS repeater. Uplink is on VHF (Yaesu VX-6R with a speaker
mic into a hand-aimed log-periodic antenna); downlink is monitored on 70 cm
with an Alinco DJ-VX50. Each pass plan is a one-page printable PDF with a
Doppler-corrected TX/RX ladder, an azimuth/elevation sky plot and the settings
for both radios. Frequencies come from the
[AMSAT FM satellite table](https://www.amsat.org/live-fm-satellites);
availability is not guaranteed.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

ROOT = Path("..").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import upcoming

TZ = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")
```

## Upcoming passes

Next 48 hours, 10° and up, computed from fresh TLEs at render time (re-render to
refresh). Rows with a plan link have a printable PDF; make more with
`uv run sat_cue_sheets.py --start <ISO local time> --days <n> --min-el 10`.
Listen-only satellites (no uplink to use) have no plan.

```{python}
#| label: upcoming
import re

plans = {}
for f in (ROOT / "data" / "cue_sheets").glob("sat_*.pdf"):
    m = re.match(r"sat_(.+)_(\d{8})_(\d{4})\.pdf$", f.name)
    if m:
        plans[(m.group(1), m.group(2) + m.group(3))] = f.name

try:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    rows = []
    for r, p, s, el, az_r, az_s, name, info in upcoming.upcoming(now, now + timedelta(hours=48)):
        rl = r.astimezone(TZ)
        link = plans.get((name, f"{rl:%Y%m%d%H%M}"))
        rows.append({
            "rise (EDT)": rl.strftime("%a %m/%d %H:%M:%S"), "sat": name,
            "TX MHz": f"{info['up']:.3f}" if info["two_way"] else "",
            "RX MHz": f"{info['down']:.3f}", "max el": round(el),
            "az rise>set": f"{az_r:.0f}>{az_s:.0f}",
            "min": round((s - r).total_seconds() / 60, 1),
            "plan": f'<a href="../data/cue_sheets/{link}">PDF</a>' if link else "",
        })
    display(HTML(pd.DataFrame(rows).to_html(index=False, escape=False, classes="table table-sm", border=0)))
except Exception as exc:
    display(Markdown(f"*Could not compute upcoming passes: {exc}*"))
```

## All pass plans

```{python}
#| label: plans
items = []
for (name, stamp), fn in plans.items():
    when = datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y%m%d%H%M")
    items.append((when, name, fn))
if not items:
    display(Markdown("*No plans generated yet.*"))
for when, name, fn in sorted(items):
    display(Markdown(f"- [{when:%a %m/%d %H:%M} {name}](../data/cue_sheets/{fn})"))
```

## References

- [AMSAT live FM satellites](https://www.amsat.org/live-fm-satellites):
  frequencies, tones and status.
- [AMSAT: LilacSat-2 / CAS-3H](https://www.amsat.org/two-way-satellites/lilacsat-2-cas-3h/):
  FM transponder planned for 24 h from about 22:00 UTC on Mondays, Wednesdays
  and Fridays (flexible, subject to change).
